title: Depth imbalance
description: Bid size against ask size close to the touch, within five basis points of the midpoint. It says which side has more waiting to trade.

imbalance.label: Depth imbalance
imbalance.description: Bids minus asks over the total, from minus one to plus one. Positive means buyers are stacked closer to the price.

combined_imbalance.label: Depth imbalance
combined_imbalance.description: The same read across Coinbase and Kraken together, from minus one to plus one. Positive means buyers are stacked closer to the price.
